# Draft:The platform wars

The "Platform Wars": Comparative Architecture
In the landscape of digital development, choosing a core framework is rarely about finding the "best" tool, but rather the right tool for a specific architectural goal. The "Platform Wars" section of your wiki serves as a strategic analysis of the three titans of open-source content management: WordPress, Joomla, and Drupal.
Rather than viewing these platforms as simple website builders, this analysis treats them as Content Management Frameworks (CMFs). Each possesses a distinct philosophy regarding data structure, security, and developer extensibility. By documenting their differences, you create a decision-making matrix that dictates how a project should be built based on its complexity and scaling requirements.
Why This Analysis is Critical
Architectural Integrity: It prevents "over-engineering" a simple project or, conversely, hitting a "technical ceiling" by choosing a platform that cannot scale with your data needs.
Security & Performance: By understanding how each platform handles its core code and database queries, you can better predict vulnerabilities and optimization strategies.
API & Headless Potential: For your work in AI and Computer Vision, this section helps determine which platform provides the best REST API or GraphQL support to serve as a backend for your custom Python applications
